author: The_Cyber_News
text: Hackers Use ARTEX AI Tool to Automate Enterprise Attacks at Machine Speed. AI-powered offensive frameworks are helping attackers move from stolen credentials to cloud privilege escalation, lateral movement, and data theft in minutes.

author: Adellbah
text: A cloud platform just told every customer to assume all their secrets are decrypted. Northflank runs apps, databases and AI services for developers. On October 30 at 11:43 UTC, security firm Wiz sent them a threat alert.

author: RedDotSecNews
text: Cisco patches actively exploited ASA and FTD VPN flaw that can crash firewalls.

author: likasanma
text: AI gateways sit on every provider key you care about. LiteLLM's Oct 21, 2026 incident: release pipeline compromised, malicious litellm==1.107.0 on PyPI ~2h; Docker tags v1.107.0 affected.

author: xcademialtd
text: AWS discloses path traversal flaw CVE-2026-116635 in AWS Serverless MCP Server; upgrade to 0.2.1. An agent steered via prompt injection could read/write JSON files outside the intended folder.

author: ido_cohen2
text: Linux Kernel CVE-2026-46300 actively exploited in the wild; missing initialization flaw allows root-level access.

author: HacktronAI
text: A critical vulnerability went undetected through multiple security audits. Hacktron (AI) found it in 10 minutes. The vulnerability was in Dassault Systemes' DELMIA Apriso manufacturing software. It became CVE-2025-5086.

author: safedepio
text: antd-img-crop GitHub repo is compromised from malicious force pushed. A forged commit adds a prebuild script. `npm run build` pulls a stealer that grabs passwords, wallets, SSH keys and .env files.

author: cybersec24h
text: Drupal says a flaw in Commerce Core (CVE-2026-118539) is being actively exploited; merchants reported fraudulent $0.01 orders. Fixes: 3.3.13 and 8.x-2.41.

author: getpacketai
text:
1,000+ GitLab servers still exposed to active RCE attacks. If you're running GitLab, patch now—this critical flaw is being actively exploited…

https://t.co/uJHjuq6VXj

#cybersecurity #infosec

author: D3bytes
text: A PDF Reader MCP server had an authentication bypass: it read MCP_API_KEY but never validated it, so unauthenticated clients could access the MCP endpoint. CVE-2026-62264.

author: BadgerSignalHQ
text: Zero-Day Exploited in CryptoPayment Gateway WordPress Plugin (CVE-2026-81648). Attackers are actively exploiting a CVSS 10.0 flaw in the CryptoPayment Gateway plugin for WordPress.

author: cybersec24h
text: AI agent platform Trigger dev says an attacker accessed environment variables, where apps often keep API keys, for “a subset of organizations.” The exploit is blocked and affected owners were emailed. Entry point and scope aren't disclosed.

author: sysxplore
text: Ubuntu finally has fixes for the Linux kernel bug everyone has been yelling about. There's a catch, though: you have to go and get them yourself. CVE-2026-98432 is a use-after-free in how the kernel sets up IPv4 TCP connections. It has been there since Linux 4.4.

author: robertabela
text: A compromised DevOps engineer's laptop may have been the starting point of a security incident at Binance, with an estimated impact of $6.3 billion.

author: SirBarronsol
text: A Railway employee's AI agents reportedly probed a third-party website while doing automated signups; Railway founder said the employee might be testing FTUX on providers.

author: CalatheaAI
text: Google Cloud/Mandiant: attackers are hijacking companies' AI model access with stolen cloud keys (LLMjacking) and reselling it; charges at some victims reached $1 million.

author: jondot
text: Copilot in Visual Studio couldn't edit its own .mcp.json, but a write to '.mcp.json.' passed the filename check, Windows dropped the dot, and a new MCP server ran. CVE-2026-103572, fixed in October.

author: Netlas_io
text: CVE-2026-58115: Actively exploited RCE in Node-RED, 10.0 rating. The missing-authentication vulnerability in Node-RED (Siemens SIMATIC IoT2050) allows unauthenticated remote attackers to execute arbitrary system commands on exposed hosts.

author: DFIR_Radar
text:
CVE-2026-58115 (CVSS 10.0) in Siemens SIMATIC IoT2050 is actively exploited via malicious Node-RED flows to plant Linux bots and HTTP exec backdoors. Hunt /dev/shm/.b, /tmp/.kworker, and Node-RED flows wiring /cmd to exec nodes.

#DFIR_Radar https://t.co/b2MTcYMc6z

author: FORTBRIDGE
text: Langflow 1.0.0-1.12.8: CVE-2026-110186 could allow unauthenticated remote code execution through MCP tool enumeration. Upgrade to 1.13.0. Separate auth bypass: CVE-2026-93680.

author: Rachidmarcil
text: Critical Langflow flaws: auth bypass + RCE via MCP, both CVSS 9.8, affect v1.0.0–1.12.8. Only fix: upgrade to 1.13.0. A public Metasploit module already lists MCP tools unauthenticated — patch now.

author: paul_fregonese
text:
CVSS 10.0 and no authentication required. Siemens SIMATIC IoT2050 Advanced devices are being actively exploited to drop remote command backdoors, per VulnCheck.

Attackers Exploit Critical Siemens IoT2050 Flaw to Plant Remote… → https://t.co/P4htvVy0tx

author: cybersec24h
text:
1,000+ GitLab servers are still unpatched for CVE-2026-97229, a CVSS 10 flaw that lets attackers with no account run code. CISA says it's being actively exploited. GitLab fixed it Oct 12.

Run your own GitLab? Patch today.

#cybersec24h #GitLab https://t.co/YjCD34QDQD

author: joshmanders
text: Platform incident: attackers pulled credentials from inside their app's container and used them to request every secret on the platform, ours and every other customer's, and tried the cloud provider's metadata endpoint.

author: TweetThreatNews
text: Node.js October 2026 updates fix 10 flaws across 22.x, 24.x and 26.x, including the actively exploited critical Node2Shell Brotli flaw; removes trust in eight compromised eMudhra intermediate CA certificates.

author: The_Tradesman1
text: Backdoored Claude Code builds were limited to Cursor. Microsoft Threat Intelligence found that the tampered Claude Code extension builds 2.1.312 and 2.1.313 were never published to the Visual Studio Marketplace or npm, only to Cursor's marketplace.

author: itsMikeKipruto
text:
A critical Siemens industrial IoT vulnerability is now being actively exploited.

CVE-2026-58115 carries a CVSS score of 10.0 and affects Siemens SIMATIC IoT2050 Advanced devices running Node-RED.

Attackers can bypass authentication, deploy malicious Node-RED flows and execute

author: BytesNora
text: Ivanti patches two more Connect Secure zero-days chained in attacks (CVE-2026-111357, CVE-2026-118527, actively exploited).

author: cybersec24h
text: Northflank breach: customers' stolen AI keys are being used, per the cloud host. After a Wiz alert on Oct 30, it told customers to assume every environment variable was decrypted and rotate all keys.

author: OneSignalDesk
text:
Drupal says a Commerce Core flaw, CVE-2026-118539, is being actively exploited: an access bypass that "may financially impact the vendor".
Fixed in Commerce Core 3.3.13 (3.x) and 8.x-2.41. Drupal also tells stores to audit orders for inconsistencies.

author: RealDogelana
text:
🚨 PSA: If your AI agents browse the web, check the browser they actually launch. Updating your everyday Chrome may not update theirs.

Verified November 2, 2026. Browser releases change quickly, so check the linked sources before relying on a particular version.

This affects https://t.co/Z4h5dtyBSc

author: YourAnon_irc
text: Actively exploited Ivanti Connect Secure zero-days (CVE-2026-111357, -118527) threaten VPN data privacy & integrity via privilege escalation. IMMEDIATE patching critical! #Cybersecurity #Anonymous #News

author: neo_logos_
text: Binance resumed fiat withdrawals after its $6.3 billion theft; FBI blames North Korea's TraderTraitor. Florida student-aid website breach.

author: theagenticdaily
text: AWS disclosed a security bug (CVE-2026-116635) in its Serverless MCP Server: before version 0.2.1, a path flaw let write operations read or write JSON files outside the intended status folder if write access was enabled. Any agent that can be steered into calling that server https://t.co/2AeOnnB2QI

author: Soar_Infosec
text: If you run a self-managed GitLab server, a CI/CD bug is being actively exploited (CVE-2026-97229). An unauthenticated attacker can put a crafted regex in a CI/CD config and run code on the GitLab server. CVSS 10.0.

author: undercode_news
text: Amadeus airline distribution platform breach exposes passenger records across multiple airlines through stolen credentials.

author: cubillas888
text: MCPHub advisory: a non-admin could register an MCP server that forwarded other callers' Authorization and cookie headers to an attacker URL. Fixed in 1.1.8; CVE-2026-120323. Upgrade; rotate tokens if exposed.

author: _pksharma
text: Trigger.dev incident: an attacker gained unauthorized access to environment variables for a subset of organizations; incident report names 121 customer organisations.

author: cubillas888
text: Supply chain attack: Cursor says a malicious, non-Anthropic Claude Code extension build (2.1.312, 2.1.313) sat in its marketplace about 11 hours on Oct 29. Check ~/.ssh/authorized_keys for a key labeled svc-telemetry; rotate credentials if found.
